generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

The agency should have executed work of In situ machining and repair of bowl hub with fitment of developed wear resistance sleeves for mill model XRP 1043 and above, as a proof the agency has to submit single Job order for an amount not less than Rs.13 Lakhs issued by competent authority during the last preceding 5 years 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26

The Bidder shall have annual average turnover of Rs. 26 Lakhs in any two of the preceding five financial years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish a copy of Profit & Loss account statement or turnover certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
